target: Classify ordinary pass-equivalence of oriented closed virtual knots and develop corresponding concordance/cobordism invariants.
accepted_conclusions: Kauffman odd writhe modulo four is invariant under ordinary oriented passes; the one-pass change lies in {-4,0,4}.
A complete six-arrow ordinary-pass pair attains the bound four, giving a sharp pass-distance lower bound and the exact restriction on odd-writhe moduli.
An explicit flat-trivial RII-based two-arrow witness and insertion proof separate at least two ordinary pass classes in every oriented flat fiber.
The universal additive n-writhe quotient is A/R isomorphic to B direct sum Z/2, with actual geometric realizations of arbitrary integer potentials and both local orientations covered.
remaining_gap: Full ordinary-pass knot classification; sufficiency of flat type plus the binary obstruction; classical trefoil versus unknot through virtual intermediates; and the broader concordance/cobordism request.
